title: Time-based orphan cleanup deleted state files of live idle sessions
description: cleanup_orphans removed any 'waiting' state file older than 30 min even when the session's pane and process were alive, so idle sessions' lights vanished; PostToolUse/Notification refused to recreate missing files so the light stayed gone until the next prompt. Fixed: pane liveness is the source of truth (time threshold only when the pane list is unreadable or no pane recorded), empty pane list treated as unavailable, and PostToolUse/Notification now recreate missing state files (self-healing).
close_reason: Fixed: hook_handler falls back to cwd->pane resolution for daemon-hosted sessions; cleanup uses pane liveness as source of truth with time threshold only as fallback; PostToolUse/Notification recreate missing state files. Covered by tests/test_lights.py.

title: No light for daemon-hosted background sessions (no TMUX_PANE in hook env)
description: Claude Code can host a session's agent loop in a daemon bg-pty-host worker (observed after auto-update + /login: daemon.log 'bg claimed-spare fe193bf1 (slash)'). Hooks execute in the worker, which has no TMUX_PANE, so hook_handler.py returned early and never wrote a state file — the window showed no light all session. Fixed by find_pane_by_cwd(): fall back to previously recorded pane, then match event cwd against pane_current_path, preferring non-shell foreground panes; ambiguous matches write nothing.
close_reason: Fixed: hook_handler falls back to cwd->pane resolution for daemon-hosted sessions; cleanup uses pane liveness as source of truth with time threshold only as fallback; PostToolUse/Notification recreate missing state files. Covered by tests/test_lights.py.
